ns2:group.ns2:title: Foshan’s viral “chicken pot” boss said no To 1,000 free chickens
ns2:group.ns2:description:
A viral restaurant in Foshan just turned down 1,000 free chickens.
Mo’s Chicken Pot owner “Lao Mo” said he refused the offer because he had no space to store them — and denied online claims that he insulted the sender.
The offer came from Wens Foodstuff Group, which said the delivery has not gone through due to logistics issues, adding it is now discussing broader cooperation with the restaurant.
Lao Mo also said he sources chickens from local households, and that the company’s supply does not meet his requirements.

ns2:group.ns2:title: Robots just ran a half marathon at night
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Humanoid robots are getting faster — and more independent.
At a full-scale night test for the 2026 Humanoid Robot Half Marathon in Beijing’s Yizhuang, dozens of teams ran autonomous and remote-controlled robots through a simulated race course.
Speeds were noticeably higher than last year, with larger humanoid robots completing the course without human assistance. From fast sprinters to smaller, playful designs, robots handled navigation, pacing and coordination on their own.
